specialist_trade.label: Specialist trade
specialist_trade.value: Concrete pumping (truck-mounted boom placement of ready-mix concrete) plus concrete waste washout management (Eco-Pan)

trade_licenses_workforce_qualification.label: Trade licenses / workforce qualification
trade_licenses_workforce_qualification.value: Highly skilled, highly trained pump operators; emphasis on training and safety

typical_contract_job_size.label: Typical contract / job size
typical_contract_job_size.value: Fee-based per-job pumping services with no bonding requirements; mostly many small-to-mid-sized individual placements across construction sites
